pqcParsing.note: Probed functionally -- keys are generated and signed with, not merely imported, because a module can be present and non-functional when the linked OpenSSL lacks the primitive. This build can both use ML-DSA keys and issue ML-DSA certificates, so a post-quantum certificate is classifiable through the structured path. SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) is absent: a FIPS 205 signature would reach the structured parser and fail. Only the OID fallback in audit/pqc_oid.py records it, as a finding rather than an error.
